newsitem.title: USA: Andean Development gets $500,000 in project.
newsitem.headline: Andean Development gets $500,000 in project.

text.p: Andean Development Corp said it earned more than $500,000 as a consultant for the Central Costanera project.
Central Costanera SA, 60 percent owned by Endesa SA, is the main utility of Buenos Aires, Argentina. It will cost $280 million and will be finished by December 1998, Andean said.

Andean said it acted as a consultant for Central Costanera when the utility issued a purchase order earlier this month for a 832 megawatt gas-fired combined cycle power plant to Japan's Mitsubishi Corp.
The power plant will be the largest compound ever built in South America, Andean said.
